relations.note: structural link (prerequisite: 'You must create a Search index before you can run a search with the Search Service.')

cross_component_finding.observation: This page documents running a Search query from SQL++ (N1QL) via the Query tab and SEARCH() functions - a genuine cross-component bridge between the search/ and n1ql/ doc trees within the same product (Couchbase Server), not just structural navigation.
cross_component_finding.evidence: Use the Query tab to search using natural-language search and SQL++ features in the same query. For more information about how to use the Search Service from a SQL++ query, see Search Functions.

competency_questions_addressed: What are all the ways to run a Search query against a Search index?
